In stock at $59.99; plus shipping (US warehouse 3–5 business days when US inventory is available; confirm rate at checkout). eBay $24.99 single / $44.99 2-pack listings were out of stock today. links.title: Quansheng UV-K5/K6 ham 2-pack (custom firmware, NOT GMRS-certified)
links.note: Best “cool software” radio (egzumer / F4HWN custom firmware, CHIRP, USB-C charging, NOAA receive). It is NOT FCC-certified for GMRS. Transmitting on GMRS with it is illegal. Legal transmit is amateur (ham) bands only, and each operator needs a Technician license — a GMRS family license does not cover it. Some custom firmware has a simple messenger, but it is not a good primary texting system. Amazon 2-pack B0D8GLNY11 is out of stock; B0CZ97PH4P stock/price was not fully confirmed today (previously $54.34). No used found.

links.title: Recommended 2-person prep kit: GM-30 pair + 2 T-Echo + GMRS license
links.note: One-time cost, no subscriptions. Radioddity GM-30 2-pack $59.99 (plus shipping) for legal GMRS voice, NOAA alerts, and Pinellas/Tampa repeaters; two LILYGO T-Echo 915 MHz $64.97 each ($129.94, free US shipping from Rokland) for off-grid text and GPS via the Meshtastic phone app (e-ink screen still works if phones die); FCC GMRS license $35 for 10 years covering you and your wife. Total about $224.93 plus GM-30 shipping and tax. Cheaper texting swap: two SenseCAP T1000-E cards (~$80) instead of the T-Echos.

links.title: TIDRADIO TD-H3 unlocked 2-pack (official, cheaper but not legal GMRS)
links.note: In stock at $49.99. USB-C programming cable included, Odmaster app, CHIRP, NOAA receive, and some open-source firmware. Unlocked (ham+GMRS) units are not legal to transmit on GMRS. Shipping 5–9 business days in the US; confirm shipping at checkout. Skip this if the goal is legal GMRS with your wife.

links.title: BTECH GMRS-PRO (premium all-in-one with off-grid text/GPS)
links.note: FCC-certified GMRS, IP67, 2600mAh, USB-C, NOAA, app programming, off-grid short texts and GPS sharing with no subscription. Voice can use GMRS repeaters; texts/GPS are simplex only (radio-to-radio, not through repeaters) and only work with other GMRS-PROs. Ships from the USA, typically 1–4 business days. Two plus the $35 family license is about $369 before tax. No cheaper used/open-box found today.

links.title: LILYGO T-Echo 915 MHz Meshtastic (best easy off-grid text/GPS)
links.note: License-free LoRa (US 915 MHz), no subscription. Pairs with the Meshtastic phone app for off-grid text and GPS; 1.54-inch e-ink screen still works if phones are dead. In stock (26 when checked) at Rokland; US orders $20+ ship free. Range is typically a few miles per hop in the open, less in town, and can extend through a mesh. This does not replace GMRS voice or GMRS repeaters, and it does not receive NOAA alerts.

links.title: SenseCAP T1000-E Meshtastic card (cheaper pocket text/GPS)
links.note: Credit-card size, IP65, built-in GPS, pairs with the Meshtastic phone app, no subscription, no license. $39.90 official; also $39.90 + $4.99 shipping at Mouser or DigiKey. Seeed sometimes takes 10% off two or more (about $71.82 before shipping) — confirm stock and the discount at checkout. ~2-day battery and no screen, so you need the phone to text. No used/open-box bargain found.

links.title: Motorola Talkabout T802 2-pack (FRS app texting, not long-distance)
links.note: License-free FRS with NOAA alerts and off-grid app texting/location between T800-series radios only (needs a phone in each hand). No GMRS repeaters and only FRS power, so real neighborhood range is a couple of miles, not long-distance. Rocky Talkie radios do not text. Skip this if you want to hit Pinellas/Tampa GMRS repeaters.

links.title: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3 915 MHz (DIY Meshtastic, cheapest board)
links.note: Cheapest Meshtastic board ($26.97 at Rokland, 65 in stock, free shipping over $20). Needs a battery and a case, GPS is not built in, and battery life is poor unless you build it out. Fine as a nerd project, not as your wife’s everyday prep radio. Prefer the T-Echo or T1000-E.

links.title: Cheapest texting radio (ThinkNode M2 Meshtastic, buy 2)
links.note: Cheapest radio set that can text: buy 2 for about $41.62 plus shipping. Comes with Meshtastic installed, a 1.3-inch OLED screen and a 1000mAh battery, and no GPS. Text through the Meshtastic phone app over Bluetooth; no license or subscription. Text only, no voice, and shorter range than GMRS. Ships from China; Rokland (US) had it for about $24.97 in Oct. In stock at Elecrow on Nov 17.
